summary: Tache, a Party for Socialism and Liberation candidate, explicitly calls the war in Gaza a genocide and demands the immediate end of all U.S. aid to Israel, framing it as a structural feature of capitalism rather than a mere policy choice. At a November 2023 Boston City Council meeting he told councilors that U.S. money funds Palestinian deaths and inaction enables genocide. In a 2026 interview he described opposing U.S. weapons and funding to Israel as a matter of conscience.
